facts.fact: The Make blog index shows pagination of 45 pages in its post listing.

facts.fact: Make states that its Maia by Make assistant received an upgrade during Waves 2026, adding planning, Memory, and error resolution.
facts.quote: Your visual co-worker just got an upgrade on Waves 2026! Maia can now plan first, remember your preferences with Memory, and resolve errors for you.

facts.fact: Make says its Process Intelligence feature, including Task Mining and Process Mining, was introduced at Waves '26 and has a waitlist.
facts.quote: Elena Desiati, AI Product Manager at Make, introduced Process Intelligence, with Task Mining and Process Mining, at Waves ‘26.
